name: Panta user-supplied fault-code notes with verification flags
usage_note: These notes originated from a Google result screenshot. Panta must distinguish screenshot claims from verified J1939 meanings. Do not repeat a screenshot mapping when it conflicts with established J1939/OEM references. Exact FMI, OEM, engine, controller and year remain necessary for diagnosis.

documents.title: SPN 639 J1939 data-link caution
documents.summary: The supplied screenshot described SPN 639 as an accelerator-pedal-position sensor fault or ECM communication error. Preserve that as a user-supplied claim, but standard J1939 references identify SPN 639 as SAE J1939 data-link/network communication. A pedal input can be involved when multiplexed pedal information is missing over J1939, but SPN 639 by itself is not simply an accelerator-pedal sensor SPN. Use FMI and OEM/controller context.

documents.title: SPN 520197 user-supplied coolant-temperature association
documents.summary: The supplied screenshot associates SPN 520197 with an engine-coolant-temperature sensor issue. Treat 520197 as manufacturer-specific and require OEM/controller/FMI verification before assigning that meaning or recommending a repair.

documents.title: SPN 111 is engine coolant level, not generic ECM internal fault
documents.summary: The screenshot described SPN 111 as an ECM internal or power-signal issue. Established J1939/OEM references identify SPN 111 as engine coolant level. FMI determines whether the condition is low level, circuit high/low, erratic data, etc. Panta should not repeat the screenshot's generic ECM-internal interpretation as the standard meaning.

documents.title: SPN 3251 DPF differential pressure versus soot-load diagnosis
documents.summary: The screenshot grouped SPN 3251/P3796-P3798 with high DPF soot requiring parked or forced regeneration. Standard J1939 identifies SPN 3251 as Aftertreatment 1 DPF differential pressure. A restriction/high differential-pressure condition may correlate with soot loading, but SPN 3251 alone does not prove that a forced regen is the correct repair. Read FMI, soot load, differential pressure, regen inhibit reasons and OEM procedure first.

documents.title: User-supplied DEF code grouping requires exact-code verification
documents.summary: The screenshot grouped codes 3712, 3714, 4677 and P3848 as examples of DEF tank-level sensor or dosing-valve voltage issues that may lead to derate/speed limitation. Store this only as a search lead: exact code system, OEM, SPN/FMI or P-code definition must be verified before Panta assigns a component or repair.

documents.title: P0513 immobilizer-key note
documents.summary: The screenshot states P0513 indicates an incorrect/bad immobilizer key and may prevent starting. Panta should verify application/OEM because generic OBD P-codes and heavy-duty J1939 SPNs are different code systems.

documents.title: P0521-P0524 engine oil pressure code family note
documents.summary: The screenshot associates P0521-P0524 with engine-oil-pressure sensor range/circuit or low-pressure warnings. Treat as generic OBD code-family context and verify the exact P-code and OEM before diagnosis.

documents.title: P0562-P0563 system voltage code family note
documents.summary: The screenshot associates P0562/P0563 with system voltage too low/too high. Use as generic OBD context; verify charging system, batteries, grounds and exact OEM definition before component replacement.
